request.spec:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).
A change of the sheet's today that puts a claim past its due-by, or takes one out of overdue, is
such a change even when no due or due-total moved.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).
A change of the sheet's today that puts a claim past its due-by, or takes one out of overdue, is
such a change even when no due or due-total moved.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is in and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

Every ROLLUP line now ends with `overdue-total=<…>` and every TOTALS line with `overdue-total=<total>`. A change that moves only someone's overdue-total now writes these lines too. That includes changing the sheet's today so that a claim becomes overdue, or stops being overdue.

Until now the overdue figures were only worked out in the front end, so I added the same calculation on the server in `rollup/Rollup.java`. It counts an open or pending claim as overdue when its due-by is before the sheet's today. Each overdue claim adds its full figure, including any late charge. The overdue-total is not held to the sheet's cap, which matches the screen.

The other changes are both in the same folder:
- **`Figures.java`**: each person's figures and the sheet totals now carry an overdue-total. A person counts as moved when it changes.
- **`RollupLines.java`**: adds the new field at the end of both lines. TOTALS is now also written when only the overdue total moved.

All the actions that already wrote rollup lines, including changing today, pick this up without further changes. The few that don't write rollup lines (periods, roles, patrons, retire) don't change any claim figures, so I left them alone.
